conclusion: Owner reports basic recognition and held-Space flow working. Full microphone/device/echo qualification remains open.

cases.name: Basic live recognition
cases.notes: Owner reports good recognition; language, accuracy and audio route remain unmeasured.

cases.name: Basic held-Space interaction
cases.notes: Qualitative acceptance of the instructed interaction; individual focus/lifecycle cases are not inferred.

cases.name: Permission and device/route intake
cases.notes: Success does not identify the OS permission host or input/output device.

cases.name: Natural English partial/final, correction and explicit Submit
cases.notes: Observe draft updates, edit words and explicitly submit; no personal transcript retention needed.

cases.name: Natural German partial/final, correction and explicit Whisper
cases.notes: Select German explicitly; observe draft, correct and submit with Whisper enabled.

cases.name: Tap typing, release and no automatic submission
cases.notes: Separately confirm short taps type spaces and release stops capture without sending.

cases.name: Stop, close and language-switch cancellation
cases.notes: Check each transition during capture; retired sessions must not change a later draft.

cases.name: External app focus loss and recovery
cases.notes: Switch to another app while holding; return, release and start a fresh hold.

cases.name: Successful save/load while key held
cases.notes: Requires a disposable save context; existing reset-seam automation is not this physical test.

cases.name: Input loss and recovery
cases.notes: Requires an appropriate removable input and owner-enabled device change; no such action performed.

cases.name: Permission denial and recovery
cases.notes: No OS permission revocation/change performed or assumed authorized.

cases.name: Quiet/noisy speech and accent conditions
cases.notes: Record selected language and self-described conditions; one operator cannot qualify accents broadly.

cases.name: Headphone reply interruption
cases.notes: With Speak replies on, hold Space during a reply; separately test Listen only with headphones.

cases.name: Speaker feedback/echo
cases.notes: Separate speaker-on trial required. Energy/VAD cancellation is not echo cancellation.

cases.name: Offline operation/network failure
cases.notes: No physical network setting change performed; local architecture alone is not an offline test.

prior_automated_evidence: Reuse published Space verification for synthetic/native checks. These are not physical session passes.
